title: Count Complete Subarrays In An Array
statement:
A nonempty contiguous subarray is complete when it contains every distinct value that appears in the entire array. Given `nums`, return the number of complete subarrays.

## Examples

```text
Input: nums = [1,3,1,2,2]
Output: 4
```

```text
Input: nums = [5,5,5,5]
Output: 10
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= nums.length <= 1000`
- `1 <= nums[i] <= 2000`
